div.div: Memoise completed messages, virtualise long conversations, and never flash a half-streamed code fence.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 756px; height: 1px; padding-top: 553px; margin-left: 40px;

div.div: Cancellation is a feature, not an edge case: abort the fetch and tell the server, or you keep paying for tokens nobody will read. And the API key never leaves your server — a key in the bundle is a public key.
